notes: DS BIOS auto-fetch from your Drive: put your own bios7/bios9/firmware in a 'BIOS' subfolder of your linked Google Drive folder, and PokeTracker downloads them into place automatically (or tap Fetch under Settings → Built-in DS player → Nintendo DS BIOS) — so encrypted DS ROMs boot on your phone without manual file-picking. Also fixes the Updates screen: the Download button now stays pinned at the top so it's always reachable, even with long release notes (the notes scroll on their own).
